sentence_stem: Even though the train was late,
correct_completion: we arrived at the meeting on time.
full_sentence: Even though the train was late, we arrived at the meeting on time.
acceptable_variants: we still reached the meeting on time.
we managed to get there punctually.

options.text: so we missed the meeting entirely.
options.why_wrong: 'So' introduces a result that follows naturally from the delay. The sentence needs an unexpected outcome after 'even though', not a predictable consequence.

options.text: we arrived at the meeting on time.

options.why_wrong: This describes the setting but gives no outcome, so it does not complete the contrast set up by 'even though'.

options.text: we had to take a taxi instead.
options.why_wrong: This describes an expected response to the delay rather than an unexpected result, so it does not express the concessive contrast.

explanation: 'Even though' introduces a concession, so the main clause must show an outcome that goes against what the delay would normally cause. Learners sometimes choose a predictable consequence, but the concessive connector requires a contrast.
translation: Tren geç kalmasına rağmen toplantıya zamanında vardık.
